description:
Create comprehensive tests to validate the TPC-DS stdout fix and prevent
future regressions. Tests must cover:

1. Binary-level tests (dsdgen accepts -FILTER Y and outputs to stdout)
2. Integration tests (BenchBox can use streaming datagen)
3. Backward compatibility (file-based generation still works)
4. Data validation (stdout output matches file output)

These tests should run in CI to catch any regressions if the TPC source
is updated in the future.
